idea-plugin.name: Olen Engine Support
idea-plugin.description:
English

Dedicated IntelliJ IDEA tooling support for the Olen 2D Game Engine.

Features

  • Key Indexing: Indexes asset keys (Texture, Sound, Music, Sprite, Event, Fw) across the project.
  • Smart Auto-Completion: Prioritizes valid asset and engine keys within String literals.
  • Reference & Navigation: Resolves key usage sites to registration points via Go to Declaration (Ctrl+Click / Cmd+Click).
  • Static Analysis (Annotator): Warns about undefined or unregistered asset keys directly in the editor.
  • Rename Refactoring: Safely renames asset keys and their usages simultaneously (Shift + F6), bypassing standard Java identifier limitations.

한국어

Olen 2D 게임 엔진 개발을 위한 IntelliJ IDEA 전용 지원 플러그인입니다.

주요 기능

  • 키 인덱싱: 프로젝트 전반의 에셋 키(Texture, Sound, Music, Sprite, Event, Fw)를 백그라운드 색인합니다.
  • 스마트 자동완성: 리터럴 내부에서 유효한 엔진 에셋 및 이벤트 키를 최우선 순위로 제안합니다.
  • 참조 및 선언 이동: 사용처에서 정의부로 점프(Ctrl+클릭 / Cmd+클릭)할 수 있도록 PSI 참조를 연결합니다.
  • 정적 검사 (Annotator): 등록되지 않거나 오타가 난 키를 감지하여 에디터에 에러를 표시합니다.
  • 안전한 이름 변경 (Rename): 특수문자가 포함된 리소스 키 경로도 Java 식별자 제약 없이 일괄 리팩토링(Shift + F6)할 수 있습니다.

Suomi

Olen 2D -pelimoottorille omistettu kehitystyökalujen tuki IntelliJ IDEAan.

Keskeiset ominaisuudet

  • Avainten indeksointi: Indeksoi projektin laajuisesti resurssiavaimet (Texture, Sound, Music, Sprite, Event, Fw) taustalla.
  • Älykäs automaattitäydennys: Ehdottaa kelvollisia moottorin resurssi- ja tapahtuma-avaimia ensisijaisina merkkijonoliteraaleissa.
  • Viittaukset ja siirtyminen: Yhdistää avaimen käyttöpaikat määrittelykohtiin Go to Declaration -toiminnon kautta (Ctrl+Click / Cmd+Click).
  • Staattinen analyysi (Annotator): Havaitsee ja varoittaa määrittelemättömistä tai virheellisistä avaimista suoraan editorissa.
  • Turvallinen uudelleennimeäminen: Mahdollistaa resurssiavainten ja niiden viittausten turvallisen refaktoroinnin (Shift + F6) myös erikoismerkkejä sisältävillä poluilla ilman Javan tunnisterajoituksia.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.2

  • Fixed key completion and error inspection to strictly isolate Sound and Music categories.
  • Fixed syntax error in CompletionConfidence autopopup offset check.
  • Bumped KeyIndex version to 11 to invalidate stale index caches.
  • Refactored and translated all internal code comments and Javadoc to English.

0.2.1

  • Initial release for Olen Engine PRE 0.2.1.
  • Added FileBasedIndex for engine resource keys.
  • Added custom RenamePsiElementProcessor supporting special characters in asset paths.
  • Enhanced Fw qualifier resolution to eliminate false positives in collection methods (add/get).
  • Tested on IntelliJ IDEA 2025.2 (Build #IC-252.26199.169).
